description: This file defines the SeoUrl class responsible for handling SEO-friendly URL rewriting and decoding in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for URL rewriting, decoding, and managing SEO regexes and URL mappings.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Handles SEO URL rewriting and decoding for the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Decodes incoming SEO URLs into internal route parameters, handling URL rewriting based on SEO regexes and URL mappings.

methods.name: rewrite
methods.description: Converts a standard URL into an SEO-friendly URL by replacing query parameters with SEO keywords using regexes and URL mappings.
